name: inverse-bid-ensemble-v1
scope: Full-year in-sample inverse bid calibration, not recovered actual bids, untouched validation, posterior inference or a forecast confidence interval

price_proposal.features: Constant, annual sine/cosine, first local-clock daily sine/cosine; existing hashed calendar columns0,1,2,3,4, including DST
price_proposal.interpretation: Fit observed-minus-parent-cleared price only where at least one local resource offer is interior and matches the saved dual. This is a proposal heuristic, not a unique causal marginal-generator label. Unsupported groups get zero coefficients.

mix_proposal.coverage: Require all12 Ember national months; compare annual sum of conditional allocation bounds with annual reference, not an hourly generation-derived availability
mix_proposal.rule: -15 times signed reference outside annual interval /max(reference,1), clipped +/-15, distributed to columns by original source-nameplate country shares

bid_rule: Accepted annual refit bid + clipped accumulated smooth price/mix adjustment + nonnegative monotone gas/coal block premium; final floor0. Nuclear has no peaking block. Other bids and every physical input unchanged.
regularization: Availability-weighted mean square bid departure from accepted bids, normalized by maximum family departure105/85/15 EUR/MWh
selection: At each round choose the eligible minimum regularized objective among all completed states, baseline included. Ties prefer lower penalty then earlier ordinal. Exactly two rounds; identical bid hashes reuse an existing witness.

ensemble.selection: Among eligible distinct bid states within both best-score+0.01 and best-MAE+1, retain best first, then greedily maximize minimum normalized RMS parameter distance to retained states; ties prefer lower score then earlier ordinal
ensemble.interpretation: Equal-weight descriptive finite fit ensemble; no probability weights, posterior or calibrated uncertainty claim. Report observed-hour coverage of min/max envelope even if poor. Mean prices are a descriptive average, not a single cleared network. No investment run in this experiment.

fixed: Accepted capacity/availability, demand, fixed hydro, source chronology, PTDF/GSK/grid/link/island constraints, monthly fuel anchors and inherited calendar coefficients; no source sensitivity adopted
gates: All41 eligible observed-price zones and all48 modeled areas, negative/extreme hours, independent source/native-physics/primal-dual/monthly quantity/search-selection replay. Research filters are experimental screens, not new product acceptance criteria. No automatic baseline or browser promotion.
